pr_title: Fix #27578: Ensure atomic feedback thread and first message creation
pr_body:
## Description

Resolves #27578: **[BUG]: Feedback thread creation may leave a thread without its initial message**

### Fix
Decorated _create_models_for_thread_and_first_message with @transaction_services.run_in_transaction_wrapper to ensure atomic creation.

Closes #27578
